bead.title: fizeau: tag release with CONTRACT-003 v2 additions; downstream notification
bead.description: Cut a tagged release (likely v0.10.0 or appropriate) once contract + types + echo + tests are merged. Notify downstream consumers (DDx in particular) so they can bump their import (per project memory: ddx must always import properly tagged agent releases; no go.mod replace).
bead.acceptance: 1. Release tag pushed. 2. Release notes mention the new fields + reserved-key extensions + Power return field. 3. DDx repo notified (e.g., comment on the corresponding DDx S10_1 bead, or PR opened against ddx go.mod).
